scope: Existing capability domain, extended with external data consumption
required_controls: timeouts and retry budget with jitter and Retry-After
reference period distinct from retrieval time
freshness quality SLOs and observable failures
Versioned semantic context and host-neutral typed plan
Server-side query compilation and read-only bounded execution
Query and transformation evidence with immutable snapshots
Grain and cardinality reconciliation before aggregation
Independent numeric oracle and uncertainty-aware interpretation
maturity_limits: Local single JSON-resource reference, no distributed guarantees
No automatic pagination, scheduling or complete connector certification
Custom lineage manifest is not certified OpenLineage
Outlier is a review candidate, not fraud evidence

interfaces.consumer: source configuration, authorized data, frequency and semantics

prior_candidate_reference.adoption: Controls reconciled as candidate reference; ingestion implementation not included
